Q5503.reason: Lack of notice before a court-ordered taking is a classic procedural due process defect; compensation need not be fixed before the taking if a deposit secures it.

Q5504.reason: FRE 806 allows impeachment of a hearsay declarant, but a conviction more than 10 years after release is admissible only under the heightened 609(b) balancing test; burglary by stealth is not automatic crimen falsi.

Q5506.reason: Rapid transfusion needs the largest bore available; among these sizes 18-gauge has the greatest internal diameter and therefore the highest flow.
